beats.title: AI-Augmented Engineering
beats.text: Beyond raw chat prompting lies AI-Augmented Engineering: deterministic architecture, accelerated by autonomous coding agents.

beats.title: Deterministic PRDs & Agent Skills
beats.text: Every system starts with Deterministic PRDs — locking relational ERDs, OpenAPI contracts, and RBAC rules like BuildFlow ERP's twelve domain modules — steered by twenty-one Agent Skills built through disciplined prompt engineering.

beats.title: Claude Code, Antigravity & Craftrig MCP
beats.text: Claude Code and Google Antigravity execute in parallel, governed by custom TypeScript MCP servers I built — led by Craftrig MCP and Three.js Visual QA — enforcing topological task DAGs, exclusive file locks, and verified evidence gates.

beats.title: Hybrid & Agentic RAG
beats.text: Hybrid and Agentic RAG fuses Supabase pgvector semantic search with BM25 lexical reranking through Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion — hitting ninety-one point six seven percent recall, one point zero MRR, six hundred ninety-four millisecond Redis speed, and a self-critic grounding loop.

beats.title: Full-Stack Production Matrix
beats.text: Production layers span React nineteen, Next.js sixteen, Vue, Tailwind four, and Framer Motion — powered by Node, NestJS, Express, Hono, and Laravel on PostgreSQL, Prisma, Neon, Redis BullMQ outbox queues, and offline Dexie — across TypeScript, Python, PHP, Kotlin, and MQL5.

beats.title: Craftrig 13-Viewport QA & Edge Ship
beats.text: Every release is verified by Jest, Supertest, and Craftrig's thirteen-viewport Playwright audits, then shipped via GitHub Actions to Vercel and Cloudflare Workers. Engineered to ship — verified to last.
